title: Carrier image sha256 manifest (OC1B §12, single part)

image.note: Image parts NEVER enter git; this manifest is the record.

built_from.guest_cpu: -cpu max (TCG arm64 host; Bun runtime needs x86-64-v3/AVX2)
built_from.method: base copy -> NoCloud seed (build-local key) -> provision boot (apt+installer) -> poweroff -> check boot

verify: shasum -a 256 <image> must equal the sha256 above (as-checked state; guest writes append on boot)
